rows.sprk_documenttypedescription: Closing statement for a commercial transaction or M&A deal: buyer and seller, parties, purchase-price tabulation and closing-date facts.
Asset purchase agreement covering the acquired and excluded assets, purchase price, allocations, representations and warranties.
USPTO or PCT patent application: title, inventors, claims, specification, abstract and priority dates.
USPTO Office Action correspondence — application number, mailing date, response due date, examiner name, rejection types, cited references. Time-sensitive; drives docketing.
Banking and finance loan agreement: borrower, lender, principal amount, interest rate, maturity date, security description and covenants.
Non-disclosure agreement: effective date, parties, term and confidentiality scope.
General commercial contract: parties, effective date, term, obligations, payment terms, termination and governing law.
Amendment to an existing agreement: the agreement amended, the clauses changed and the effective date of the change.
Letter engaging a law firm or advisor: client, scope of work, fee arrangement, staffing and conflicts terms.
Court pleading such as a complaint, answer or counterclaim: court, case number, parties, claims and relief sought.
Motion filed with a court: the relief requested, the grounds, the movant and the filing and hearing dates.
Legal brief or memorandum of law filed in a proceeding: the issues, the argument and the authorities cited.
Letter or other formal correspondence: sender, recipient, date and subject, with any deadlines or demands it states.
Internal or advisory legal memorandum: the question presented, analysis and conclusion or recommendation.
Resolution of a board or committee: the body, the date, the matters resolved and the authorisations given.
Invoice or statement of fees: billing party, invoice number and date, billed period, line items and total amount.
Evidence or exhibit in a matter: what it is, who produced it, its date and the proceeding it relates to.
Order or judgment issued by a court or tribunal: the court, case number, date, the ruling and any deadlines it sets.
